elements.label: gravity-loaded cable, beam, shell and cubic tetrahedra
elements.caption: Four clamped cantilevers bend under gravity with nodal director arrows. Default geometry, stiffness and four HHT substeps are retained.

baymax_drop.label: resolution-6 elastic solid; visible mechanical cage
baymax_drop.caption: A filled elastic Baymax drops onto the floor, with its 84-node/204-tetrahedron mechanical cage visible around the detailed surface. No inflation.

ancf_shell_drop.label: 60-quad shell ball; dynamic floor contact
ancf_shell_drop.caption: The default small shell ball (62 nodes, 60 quads) drops onto a frictional plane using its authored material and unchanged 6 substeps, 3 Newton updates and 200 PCG iterations.

ancf_rigid_mujoco_tires.label: detailed Warthog tires; manual pressure controls
ancf_rigid_mujoco_tires.caption: Four detailed Warthog tires (2,128 nodes / 2,016 quads each) roll forward and reverse at up to ±8 RPM while nominal pressure cycles 30 → 45 → 15 → 30 kPa. The recording scripts only the existing manual controls; native 6/2/10 substep/Newton/PCG budgets are retained.

vehicle_ancf_tires.label: Warthog left/right steering with manual drive controls
vehicle_ancf_tires.caption: A Warthog drives on four deformable tires at up to 6 rad/s wheel command, turns left and right using differential wheel braking, then stops. This scripted preview uses the normal manual drive controls and default 6/2/10 substep/Newton/PCG budgets.

diffsim_ancf_tire_lift.label: static pressure optimization checked in a live rig
diffsim_ancf_tire_lift.caption: Implicit static-equilibrium gradients fit nominal tire pressure to a synthetic target axle height; the live MuJoCo rig checks the resulting height. Dynamic trajectories are not differentiated.
